info.title: Projektrack REST API
info.description: Personal access tokens with scopes (Bearer). Every request needs the scope of the operation and the permissions of the token user, as in the user interface, inside the tenant of the host.

403.description: The token lacks the scope, or the user the permission.

429.description: Too many requests for this token.
